rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No stale markers, no "fixed" retrospectives, no session biography.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Maintainer block (in scope per dispatch instructions: "a block states what is TRUE NOW, not the diff it just recorded"). L130: "(The 2026-08-12 story-ticket pass added a slide and two backing claims, both logged below; the no-claims-added clause above described the earlier slides-only pass and is kept as its record, not as a current description of the file.)" — this is a "fixed" retrospective kept on file by name ("kept as its record, not as a current description"), the exact pattern §3 bans ("TODO closed → delete; don't annotate as 'fixed' or keep changelog in file"). No "no-claims-added clause" is visible anywhere else in the current maintainer block, so the reference is also dangling. Second instance, same rule, L134: "(The old §52a acceptance note defended these fences while they lived in module prose; as exercise phases the tell no longer fires.)" — transition verb shape ("while they lived in X", "no longer fires") narrating a completed move rather than stating present-tense state. Neither is a dated-provenance header (which the corpus's own convention protects); both narrate a journey a reader who never saw the prior version would lose nothing by not reading.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Delete both parenthetical asides; the leading sentences in each note ("Emphasis budget: no bolded handles in the body..." / "Phase 4's two {{prompt:}} fences are a short soft-compound close ritual, not a buried exercise") already stand alone as complete, present-tense guidance.

Prompt register for `push-back-on-the-plan-4` is deliberately terse per dated maintainer accept-note (L138) — not a register inconsistency.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Overwrite anxiety — name overwrite default on regeneration.

Given the surrounding Push-back-moves section repeatedly designs for exactly this kind of imprecision-as-teaching-surface (see the two Story-ticket-read push-backs), this reads as a deliberate friction point with a built-in recovery rather than an unaddressed gap.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: If the maintainer wants the ambiguity closed rather than taught-through, add "if the file already has rules, keep them and add this one" inside the `ae101-m2-integrate-branch` fence itself, per §34 (binding logic must live in the fence, not the body).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Preamble before action — design around it.
